What Impact You'll Have 

 As a Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure that supports the organization's applications and services. Your role will involve working with Kubernetes, DevSecOps practices, Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, RedHat Linux, Helm, container management, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS IAM. You will play a crucial part in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of the platform, as well as optimizing performance and cost-efficiency.

 What You'll be Owning 

 GRVTY is seeking a Platform Engineer with a TS/SCI + Poly clearance (applicable to this customer) to join one of our top projects in Chantilly, VA.

 What You Must Have 

 
 Active TS/SCI with Polygraph Clearance (applicable to this customer)

 A Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent relevant experience

 Experience with Ansible and Puppet for configuration management

 Experience with RedHat Linux for OS administration

 Experience with Helm for managing Kubernetes applications

 Experience with AWS IAM for identity and access management

 Willingness and ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex issues, and drive continuous improvement initiatives within the platform infrastructure

 
 What Would be Nice to Have 

 
 Relevant certifications in Kubernetes, DevSecOps, or AWS

 Familiarity with Kubernetes for container orchestration

 Familiarity with DevSecOps practices for integrating security into the development process

 Familiarity with Terraform for infrastructure as code

 Experience working with large-scale cloud environments

We’re proud to offer a work environment that empowers our team to achieve a strong work-life balance. GRVTY provides competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for professional growth.
Our benefits package is designed to support the well-being of our employees and their families, and includes coverage in areas such as healthcare, financial wellness, retirement planning, family assistance, continued education, and paid time off.
